title: Repeated string concatenation inside large loop (quadratic complexity)
diff:
@@ -1,3 +1,5 @@
 def format_records_csv(records: list[dict]) -> str:
-    lines = [f"{r['id']},{r['name']},{r['value']}" for r in records]
-    return "\n".join(lines)
+    csv_output = ""
+    for r in records:
+        csv_output += f"{r['id']},{r['name']},{r['value']}\n"
+    return csv_output

ground_truth.description: String concatenation using += inside loop causes quadratic O(N^2) memory reallocation; use str.join instead.
